tasks.subject: Task 0: Land the spec + plan on main
tasks.description:

- [ ] PR from `spec/v2-overhaul` → `main` open, CI green

tasks.subject: Task 1: Add v2 to workflow + CodeRabbit branch targeting (PR to main)
tasks.description:
**Goal:** PRs targeting `v2` get full CI and CodeRabbit review.

**Files:**
- Modify: `.github/workflows/ci-data.yml:4-7` (pull_request.branches += v2)
- Modify: `.github/workflows/ci-lint.yml:3-10` (pull_request + push branches += v2)
- Modify: `.github/workflows/ci-codeql.yml:3-7` (push + pull_request branches += v2)
- Modify: `.coderabbit.yaml` (auto_review.base_branches += v2; `.github/**` path instruction "main only" → "main, plus v2 during the v2 overhaul")
- Do NOT touch `ci-scorecard.yml` (Scorecard scores default branch only)

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] All three workflows list `v2` under `pull_request.branches` (and `push.branches` for lint/codeql)
- [ ] `.coderabbit.yaml` `auto_review.base_branches` contains `main` and `v2`
- [ ] `.github` path instruction no longer says "main only"
- [ ] CI green on the PR; squash-merged to `main`

**Verify:** `git show origin/main:.coderabbit.yaml | grep -A3 base_branches` → shows `- main` and `- v2`

**Steps:** Branch `ci/v2-branch-filters` off main; apply exact YAML in plan doc Task 1 steps 2–5; `bun qa:ci`; commit `🚦 ci: target v2 branch in workflows` with `-s`; push via HTTPS token; PR to main; merge after green CI + review.

tasks.subject: Task 6: Source acquisition — fresh Sefaria data (spec 1.1)
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Identify the canonical Sefaria channel for the Jastrow lexicon, script a re-runnable fetch, and commit the normalized fresh source.

**Files:**
- Create: `docs/v2/source-acquisition.md`
- Create: `scripts/pipeline/fetch-source.ts` (+ `fetch-source.test.ts`)
- Create: `data/source/jastrow-source.jsonl`
- Modify: `docs/specs/2026-07-03-v2-overhaul-design.md` §7 (freeze-start row per V8, separate PR to `main`)

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] Doc records channel chosen, exact URLs, retrieval date, tool versions, and the two rejected channels with reasons
- [ ] Fetch is re-runnable + deterministic: strips `_id`, sorts by `rid`, compact JSONL, UTF-8
- [ ] Running twice → byte-identical output (`shasum` match)
- [ ] Alternate-headword field coverage counted and recorded
- [ ] Freeze-start changelog row on `main` (V8)
- [ ] PR into `v2` carries `bulk-data-ok` label; merged after review

**Verify:** `bun scripts/pipeline/fetch-source.ts && shasum data/source/jastrow-source.jsonl` twice → identical hash

**Steps:** (1) jq field census of `data/raw/*.jsonl` (baseline shape — Mongo `_id` present, old extraction likely mongoexport of `lexicon_entries`). (2) Evaluate channels per plan doc Task 6 step 2: (a) Sefaria public mongo dump via `bsondump`, (b) Sefaria-Export repo, (c) `/api/words/` spot-check; prefer shape-matching channel, expected (a) filtered to `parent_lexicon == "Jastrow Dictionary"`; if (a) unavailable → STOP, surface to maintainer. (3) Implement with unit-testable `normalizeRecord`/`sortByRid` + tests. (4) Run twice, hash-compare, write doc, freeze row (separate PR to main), gate, commit `🦄 new(pipeline): scripted sefaria fetch` with `-s`, PR into v2 with `bulk-data-ok`.


tasks.subject: Task 7: Divergence audit — fresh source vs data/raw (spec 1.2)
tasks.description:

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] Comparator reports: rids only-in-fresh, only-in-raw, per-rid field diffs (headword, alt_headwords, senseCount, "other")
- [ ] Unit tests cover: identical → no diff; missing rid each side; headword change; alt_headwords change; mixed edit (named field + remainder drift both reported)
- [ ] Audit doc summarizes counts + "silent fixes to preserve as v2 rules" list
- [ ] `bun test scripts/pipeline/` passes

**Verify:** `bun test scripts/pipeline/lib/compare-entries.test.ts` → pass; `bun scripts/pipeline/divergence-audit.ts` → writes reports, prints summary counts

**Steps:** TDD — full test + implementation code in plan doc Task 7 (interfaces: `SourceEntry`, `compareEntryMaps(fresh, raw) → {onlyInFresh, onlyInRaw, changed}`). Driver loads source vs raw JSONL, strips `_id`. Hand-inspect changed-rid sample for the doc. Gate, commit `🦄 new(pipeline): divergence audit tool` with `-s`, PR into v2 with `bulk-data-ok`.

tasks.subject: Task 8: Edit-mining — replay set from git history (spec 1.3)
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Reconstruct every manual edit to the deployed JSONL from `main`'s git history into a keyed, replayable record set.

**Files:**
- Create: `scripts/pipeline/lib/parse-jsonl-diff.ts`
- Test: `scripts/pipeline/lib/parse-jsonl-diff.test.ts`
- Create: `scripts/pipeline/mine-edits.ts`
- Create: `data/source/edit-replay.jsonl`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] Parser turns unified-diff text into `{id, op: add|remove|modify, before?, after?}` keyed by deployed `id`
- [ ] Unit tests cover: pure add, pure remove, modify, non-JSON lines ignored
- [ ] Driver walks `origin/main` history oldest→newest, skips baseline-import commit, stamps `commit` + ISO `date`
- [ ] Replay set committed; count reported; 3 records spot-checked vs `git show`
- [ ] `bun test scripts/pipeline/` passes

**Verify:** `bun test scripts/pipeline/lib/parse-jsonl-diff.test.ts` → pass; `bun scripts/pipeline/mine-edits.ts` → prints `edits=<N> commits=<M>`

**Steps:** TDD — full test, `parseJsonlDiff`, and driver code in plan doc Task 8 (pair removed+added by id → modify; `git log --format=%H%x09%cI --reverse origin/main -- <files>` then `git diff <sha>^ <sha>`, skip index 0). Gate, commit `🦄 new(pipeline): mine edit history` with `-s`, PR into v2 with `bulk-data-ok`, spot-check noted in PR body.

```json:metadata
{"files": ["scripts/pipeline/lib/parse-jsonl-diff.ts", "scripts/pipeline/lib/parse-jsonl-diff.test.ts", "scripts/pipeline/mine-edits.ts", "data/source/edit-replay.jsonl"], "verifyCommand": "bun test scripts/pipeline/ && bun scripts/pipeline/mine-edits.ts", "acceptanceCriteria": ["parser with 4 passing unit tests", "replay set committed with count", "3 records spot-checked vs git show"], "modelTier": "standard"}
```
